title: Rewind Deleted Edits From Session Transcripts
description: Write a program to parse session JSON transcript files and extract string replacements (oldString/newString), then rewind deleted edits by reversing them. Test that everything works.
summary: Wrote a Python rewind program that parses JSONL session transcripts, extracts all replace_string_in_file/multi_replace_string_in_file operations with timestamps, and supports --list, --check, --replay, --rewind, --dry-run modes with file/session/timestamp filters. Uses virtual file state tracking for correct chained edit handling. Applied 47 missing replacements to compose/sketchpad/index.tsx, 3 to compose/ui/index.tsx. Fixed duplicate useThree import. All 114 unit tests pass.
